name: swap-panel
title: Swap Panel
description: A cross-chain swap ticket: pay and receive fields, a token picker with chain filter, a live quote and an optional destination address.

props.name: chains
props.description: Chains for the picker filter: id, name, symbol (the mark) and tone (token classes for the dot).

props.name: tokens
props.description: Tokens to swap between: id, symbol, name, chainId and optional balance, usd, address, popular.

props.name: defaultFromId
props.description: Token id paid at first. Defaults to the first token.

props.name: defaultToId
props.description: Token id received at first. Defaults to the second token.

props.name: fee
props.description: Network fee in USD shown in the quote.

props.name: slippage
props.description: Slippage tolerance in percent shown in the quote.

props.name: eta
props.description: Estimated time shown in the quote.

props.name: onSwap
props.description: Called when the main button is pressed with a valid amount.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
